subject: Bespoke bars and entertaining furniture
hook: Bespoke home bars and drinks cabinets, built to fit the space and the way you entertain.
gbp:
If you enjoy having people round, a bespoke home bar or drinks cabinet gives everything a proper place: bottles, glasses, mixers and the bits you do not want on show.

SUPERIO designs and builds home bars, drinks cabinets, sideboards and entertaining furniture to fit the space you have, whether that is an alcove, the area under the stairs, a dining-room corner or the end of a kitchen run. We plan shelf heights around your bottles and glasses, closed cupboards for the less glamorous items, and space and access for a drinks fridge if you want one. Exposed edges get thicker ABS edging to cope with knocks, and soft-close hardware is standard.

Finishes include charcoal, oak-effect, black woodgrain and matt black, with antique gold or matt black handles. Everything is made in our own workshop in Hanley and installed by our own team. We also make counters and storage for offices and small commercial spaces.

We work with homeowners and businesses in Sandbach and across the area. Book a free, no-obligation design consultation using the button below.
